description: Everything an agent needs to write, gate, port, ship and debug shell scripts across operating systems and shells the way the OCX family does: the shell-quality rule (the gate block, the floor-first rule, the script kinds and fourteen depth files on dialect, errors, expansion, security, CI, installers, userland, testing, gates, multi-shell emitters, zsh, fish, nushell and elvish), the powershell-quality rule (the gate wrapper, the target by script kind and six depth files on compatibility, encoding, errors, gates, native commands and security), plus the shell-integration skill for code that writes shell code or edits startup files, the installer-script skill for curl-to-sh and irm-to-iex installers, the shell-port skill that moves a script to bash 3.2 or POSIX sh, and the shell-diagnose skill for a script, CI step or installer that is already failing. The code-docs rule and the code-docs-cleanup skill cover comments in every language: short blocks that keep every guard.
name: shell-essentials
summary: The OCX Shell set: shell and PowerShell source standards, and the integration, installer, port and diagnosis procedures
